text: Read the full histories of C_LAUNCH1 and C_LAUNCH2 to find messages whose text mentions launch, and record each such message's author and channel.
Look up the profile-shown workspace for each of the four roster candidates (U_ROSTER1, U_ROSTER2, U_ROSTER3, U_ROSTER4).

Report only the (user, workspace) membership entries for roster candidates who themselves authored a launch-related message found in step 1; exclude candidates whose channel merely contains such a message from someone else, and exclude candidates with no launch-related message in the audit histories.
